## Prep Workspace
```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Clear environment, close any open plots
rm(list = ls()); graphics.off()
  
# Load in libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(EDIutils)
library(dataRetrieval)

# Load BGC PE data
data_url <- "https://www.sciencebase.gov/catalog/item/689b9185d4be0224e628ea75"
destination_file <- "local_dataset_name.csv" # Ensure the correct file extension (e.g., .csv, .txt)

# Download the file
download.file(url = data_url, destfile = destination_file, method = "auto")


# Load PESP data
packageId <-"edi.2209.2"
read_data_package_archive(packageId, path = tempdir()) 
res <- read_data_entity_names(packageId)
entityName <- "PESP_enumeration.csv"
entityId <- res$entityId[res$entityName == entityName]
raw <- read_data_entity(packageId, entityId)
pesp <- readr::read_csv(file = raw)
pesp$Date <- as.Date(pesp$Date)
pesp <- pesp %>% arrange(Date, Time)

# Load Discrete WQ data package (with MVI)
wq <- read.csv("Data/Delta_Integrated_WQ.csv")
wq_meta <- read.csv("Data/Delta_Integrated_WQ_metadata.csv")
wq$Date <- as.Date(wq$Date)
wq <- wq %>% separate(Station, into = c("Survey", "Station"), sep = " ")
wq <- wq[, -c(2,4:5)]
wq <- wq[,c("Source","Station","Date","Datetime","Sample_depth_surface","Tide",
           "Temperature","Conductivity","Salinity","Secchi","TurbidityNTU","TurbidityFNU",
           "DissolvedOxygen","DissolvedOxygenPercent","pH","Microcystis","Chlorophyll","Pheophytin",
           "TotAmmonia","DissAmmonia","DissNitrateNitrite","TotPhos","DissOrthophos","TON","DON",
           "TKN","TotAlkalinity","DissBromide","DissCalcium","TotChloride","DissChloride","DissSilica",
           "TOC","DOC","TDS","TSS","VSS")]

# Load EMP benthic data
clam <- read.csv("Data/combined_clams_dataset.csv")
clam$station_name <- gsub("EMP ", "", clam$station_name)
clam$Date <- as.Date(clam$Date)

# Load Dayflow data
df <- read.csv("Data/Dayflow/dayflow-results-1997-2023.csv")
df$Date <- as.Date(df$Date,format = "%m/%d/%Y")
ind <- read.csv("Data/Dayflow/wy_class_ind.csv")
df$WY <- ifelse(df$Month >= 10, df$Year + 1, df$Year)
df <- merge(df,ind,by="WY",all.x=TRUE)

```
